• Spinal articulation
• Lower back and hip extensor stretch

• Lying supine with lower back and pelvis on barrel, legs straight and together, feet plantarflexed, hands holding levers, body on diagonal line
• Socket: C, Lever Orientation: 0, Lever Length: 1, Lever Direction: 5, Connector: O, Spring: Y/S

• Inhale: Lift legs to 90 degree in hip joint
• Exhale: Roll over, legs parallel to floor
• Inhale: Dorsiflex feet, separate legs, lower legs toward mat
